play_notes: Round 2 replay (2 min, 390x844). Seed tap then I HEARD IT, then 3 picture tiles. Forced wrong picks: 'Not that one.' plus Sprig's neutral pose, then the hinted tile must be tapped. First correct answer at t=14.3 s: 'Yes!' with Sprig squinting and a rain drop (the first visible watering cue). Every answer now visibly changes Sprig: correct gets a drop, wrong gets a neutral pose. First sitting failed at 35.5 s: 'Sitting 1 of 4 done / Your seed had a drink.' with an AGAIN button, not zero plants and not a dead end. AGAIN restarted the sitting and worked on all three tries (t=35.9, 70.9, 106.5 s). The garden was not revisited this round because a failed sitting does not reach SEE MY GARDEN. No JS errors; the only script error was a stale-handle race in my own driver. Must-read text: 'Listen. Tap the one that matches.', 'Not that one.', 'Yes!', 'NEXT', 'AGAIN', 'Your seed had a drink.'
biggest_gap: The question still depends on reading the tap instruction and on a forced reset after a wrong pick. Craft polish trails Duolingo: small picture glyphs, the Tap this one pill covers the speaker icon, and the mound crops under the NEXT bar.
fixes: Move the Tap this one pill so it no longer covers the speaker glyph on card 1.
Enlarge picture glyphs in each tile to Duolingo's scale so the answer reads at a glance.
After a wrong pick, let the next correct tap advance instead of resetting the whole question.
Keep the sitting-end drink and add a plant-pot icon on AGAIN so a non-reader knows it is a retry.
Stop the mound and water drop from cropping under card 3 and the NEXT bar on the Yes screen.
